turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me.
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Setting it aside for what? The zero is why I'm here.
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
I'm not in your chair, Hale. You gave him the zero, so tell me on what basis.
